name: ROMPE
description: A living world of risk, craft and companions

regions.label: Learn by playing
regions.summary: A welcoming first journey introduces the game's loops through play. Onboarding timings are playtest sketches.

regions.label: Choose your risk
regions.summary: Blue, Yellow, Red and Black areas create a risk ladder. Loot depends on zone, flags, gear and named-map exceptions; open the source for exact rules.

regions.label: Craft, carry, trade
regions.summary: Gathering, crafted equipment, local warehouses and hauling connect the world economy. Crafted gear is deliberately losable.

regions.label: Build your account
regions.summary: An account roster can contain up to twelve characters. This is roster capacity, not twelve active companions.

regions.label: Find your people
regions.summary: Party is temporary; guild is permanent. These are parallel groupings. Promotion ends the old party, and events may override party rules.

regions.label: A world in the making
regions.summary: A candidate game design with unresolved tuning questions. Kafra guidance, invasions and world dials shape the intended adventure.
